narrative.details:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame.

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, me apologies, Rhett. Didn't spot the Torch in yer hand. An honor to meet ye proper.Many a wanderer climbs these heights chasin' tales of treasure or beasts, only to find naught but stone and silence. But we know better, don't we, Rhett?This shrine holds truths far deeper than the Alliance can fathom. To us, it's a sacred flame that waits to be awakened.
narrative.requestItemsText: Greetin's, Rhett. Ye've made it to the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame, eh? Not many do. Only those well-versed in the champion's path can grasp the secrets this place holds.Shame ye came all this way just to be turned back--the climb's no stroll through Dun Morogh. But I'm the shrine's keeper, and I won't be lettin' just any foot trod about.
